_doc: Founder b-roll bank (2026-07-06). Arielle's OWN face + bag-wall b-roll, filmed deliberately for content. PRIMARY USE = a VISUAL BED for her voiceover/opinion content: lay an existing spoken-opinion track + captions over these clips instead of a faceless slideshow/scenery bed. This is the founder-face variant in the visual-bed A/B (see docs/social-content-calendar.md 3.6). NOT the faceless scenery bank (that is broll-manifest.json). Media lives outside the repo: originals ~/Documents/handbag-campaign-images/founder-broll/originals (4K, rotation-flagged portrait); social-ready 1080x1920 H.264 in .../founder-broll/vertical (SILENT: TV background audio stripped 2026-07-06, these are visual beds only; originals keep their raw audio). rating: A=hero keeper, B=usable, C=weak/skip. status: use | hold (hold = quality skip, NOT a clearance issue). keeper rating is Claude's take; final cut is owner's.
_cleared_note: Owner cleared ALL 16 for posting (2026-07-06). 'hold' status is a quality recommendation only, not a permission gate.

sessions.A: rust/terracotta button top, hair down, glasses
sessions.B: brown tee, hair up, arm tattoo visible, glasses

clips.note: Soft look to camera, keyboard in foreground, CURTAINS behind (not the bag wall this angle). Clean neutral opener but loses the credibility backdrop.
HERO. Typing, head down then up, full bag wall behind. The 'she actually knows bags' credibility shot. Longest usable typing clip.
Sipping from speckled mug, bag wall. Warm working-moment.
Both hands on mug, looking straight to camera, bag wall. Good hook frame / eye contact.
Reaches mug toward camera, playful/cheeky. A bit much on its own; fine as a punchy cutaway.
Chin on hand, playful thinking beat. Only 2s but perfect transition / 'let me think' cutaway.
HERO. Big genuine smile straight to camera, bag wall. The warmest frame of the set. Strong opener/closer.
Holding mug, soft smile, bag wall. Reliable warm working b-roll.
Drinking, mug covers most of face. USEFUL for the face-optional need: warm and human without showing full face.
Close-up holding a small beauty product (lip gloss/sample), looking down. Off-topic for handbags; nice hands/close-up texture but not obviously on-brand. Hold unless a beauty-adjacent post needs it.
Brown tee, hand gesture on desk, looking down / mid-talk. Good b-roll under a voiceover; edges toward talking-head so keep it as silent b-roll.
Reaching both arms toward camera (looks like adjusting the phone) while talking. Reads as setup/blooper. Skip unless a specific relatable-BTS beat wants it.
Brown tee, drinking coffee, bag wall. Second-outfit coffee moment, keeps the bank from looking single-take.
HERO. Headphones on, heads-down typing, bag wall. The 'in the zone / doing the work' shot. Pairs with 7900.
HERO. Holding the black cat, smiling to camera, bag wall. Personality + scroll-stopper (cats perform). Humanizes the founder.
Petting the cat, looking down, bag wall. Warm ambient b-roll; great under a voiceover or text hook.
